issuerReservationExternalReference.description:
Reference of the offline reservation provided by the issuer
Must be unique per issuer

reason.description:
Reason for which the offline reservation is created
Free text

reservedAmount.description:
Offline reservation amount
Must be in the account currency and > 0
Must be lower than the own funds (credit balance)

value.description: Integer amount value. Ex. if it is two hundred euros and 17 cents, then amount value is 20017 (exponent = 2 digits for currency=EUR)

exponent.description: Exponent of Amount. Number of decimal digits.

isoCode.description:
Currency code of amount
The currency in ISO4217 alphabetic format.
Example: EUR for Euro
